_comment: Every script that can run long, and whether it can be smoked before it is allowed to.
每一支可能跑很久的脚本，以及它能不能在正式跑之前先过一个便宜的通路检查。
The rule (plan §2.2.1): a run expected to exceed 30 minutes may not start until a cheap end-to-end
smoke has passed. The smoke judges the PATHWAY, never the accuracy: FEMM's five silent failures were
all 'exit 0 and nothing happened', and none of them would have been caught by a longer run of the
same thing.
Three tiers, and only tier 0 lives in this gate:
* tier 0 -- preflight state, cheap: the test binaries are newer than the sources they were built
from, and the conan cache holds no cross-built package (a leftover aarch64 `foc` makes any later
link take whichever archive prints first, with an error that looks nothing like the cause).
Run with `gates.py smoke --preflight`; it is deliberately NOT part of the aggregate `all`,
because CI builds fresh and has nothing stale to find.
* tier 1 -- a minimal scenario whose answer is closed-form, finished in seconds. Owned by the
script, exposed as `--tier 1`.
* tier 2 -- the counterfactual: switch the thing under test off and the output must move. Owned by
the script, exposed as `--tier 2`.
`tier: null` means 'this script cannot be smoked yet'. That is the honest state of every script here
today, and it is a ratchet: the count is compared against `no_tier_baseline` on every run and may
only fall. A new script that appears without a `tier` decision fails the gate, because the failure
this prevents is not a wrong smoke -- it is a long scan that was never smokeable arriving quietly.

benchmark/script/analyze.py.why: post-processes a bench capture; reads files and plots, so its cost is the capture's size

benchmark/script/autotune_current_loop.p.why: searches current-loop gains against the plant; the search space is the runtime

benchmark/script/commission.py.why: drives the whole commissioning chain, so it is the longest end-to-end script here

benchmark/script/download.py.why: fetches bench material; bounded by the network, not by the model

benchmark/script/foc_sil_plant.py.why: the plant model other scripts import; it can also be run standalone over a grid

benchmark/script/golden.py.why: regenerates or compares the golden traces

benchmark/script/identify_parameters.py.why: parameter identification over several sweeps, plus an independent least-squares fit

benchmark/script/montecarlo.py.why: scatter over machine parameters and operating points; the sample count is the runtime

benchmark/script/official_cvc_check.py.why: replays the published CVC example against our loop

benchmark/script/reconcile_controller.py.why: drives motulator's controller and ours over five phases; needs the third-party package

benchmark/script/reconcile_model.py.why: drives motulator's machine and ours over 400 steps; needs the third-party package

benchmark/script/run_bench.py.why: builds and runs the on-target benchmark; minutes per configuration

benchmark/script/run_pil.py.why: runs the scenario on the target ISA under qemu and compares with the host
